move: tilted masonry columns scroll continuously in alternating directions, title breathes
how: Four columns of image tiles (five random heights from a seeded rng, duplicated once each) fill a container rotated -6deg and scaled 1.15 so the grid bleeds off every edge. Each column tweens y linearly across the whole 10s duration by exactly its one-copy span, even columns upward (0 -> -span) and odd columns downward (-span -> 0), so the last frame equals the first. A vignette darkens the edges and a centred title scales 0.96 -> 1.04 and back with sine.inOut yoyo over the duration.
adapt: Swap the three background images and caption words, the column count NCOL and tiles-per-column PER, the tilt angle and the title. Keep the linear one-span scroll per column so the seam stays invisible; change speed by changing D, not the ease.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the columns with two copies of each tile list from shot.images (using fx.rng or a seeded rng for heights) and records each column's span; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline of linear y tweens of duration D plus the title yoyo. Tile hue-rotate/saturate filters are per-tile CSS; the rotate/scale on .cols assumes a 1280x720 frame.
caveats: catalog lists 20s but the file renders 10s
up to 40 cover-image tiles with saturate/hue-rotate filters on screen at once
